description: Five stereo core frames, the third of 96 bytes (FSIZE 95): its subframes run past its end.

skip.ffprobe: ffmpeg's parser sizes the frames from the sync words it finds, so its packets differ from the short frame's
skip.decode: ffmpeg rejects the short frame ('Invalid data found when processing input')
skip.libdca: libdca's reading of the damaged frame says nothing
